name: One-handed
description: The art of combat using one-handed weapons, such as daggers, swords, maces and war axes. Those trained in this skill deliver deadlier blows.

name: Two-handed
description: The art of combat using two-handed weapons, such as greatswords, battle axes, and warhammers. Those trained in this skill deliver deadlier blows.

name: Archery
description: An Archer is trained in the use of bows and arrows. The greater the skill, the more deadly the shot.

name: Block
description: The art of blocking an enemy's blows with a shield or weapon. Blocking reduces the damage and staggering from physical attacks.

name: Smithing
description: The art of creating and improving weapons and armor from raw materials.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Those trained to use Heavy Armor make more effective use of Iron, Steel, Dwarven, Orcish, Ebony, and Daedric armors.

name: Light Armor
description: Those trained to use Light Armor make more effective use of Hide, Leather, Elven, and Glass armors.

name: Pickpocket
description: The stealthy art of picking an unsuspecting target's pockets. A skilled pickpocket is less likely to be caught and is more likely to find valuables.

name: Lockpicking
description: The art of Lockpicking is used to open locked doors and containers faster and with fewer broken lockpicks.

name: Sneak
description: Sneaking is the art of moving unseen and unheard. Highly skilled sneaks can even hide in plain sight.

name: Alchemy
description: An alchemist can create magical potions and deadly poisons.

name: Speech
description: This skill of persuasion can be used to get better prices from merchants, and persuade others to do as you ask.
